profile.a: The author as a generative AI analyst on placement at the Cambridge Centre for Alternative Finance (CCAF).
CCAF, and the financial-services firms and regulators that need to measure the cost and emissions of AI.
A method to estimate the energy use and cost of generative AI inference across cloud providers and specialist AI hosts.
Summer 2025; handed in on 12 September 2025, with projections to 2026 and 2027.
Global providers such as Microsoft Azure, Google, AWS, Meta and CoreWeave, with regional cost differences from Nordic to tropical sites.
Inference makes up 80-90% of an AI system's lifetime energy, could cost £50-80bn a year globally by 2027, and feeds into the Scope 3 emissions banks must report.

More than 50 sources classified into three evidence tracks, capital spending converted to capacity (about £8m per MW) with regional factors, power usage effectiveness, and cross-checks by capex, GPU-hours and benchmarks, delivered as a dashboard.

charts.title: Three evidence tracks for uneven disclosure

items.title: Direct capacity disclosed
items.text: Use reported capacity directly. Example: CoreWeave, estimates within plus or minus 10%.

items.title: Proxy indicators
items.text: Infer capacity from indicators such as GPU counts and campus PUE.

items.title: Financial estimates
items.text: Convert capital spending at about £8m per MW, adjusted by region.

charts.takeaway: The tracks make the uncertainty of each estimate visible instead of hiding it behind one number.

items.title: Collect
items.text: 50+ sources: SEC filings, earnings, sustainability reports, hardware specifications.

items.title: Classify
items.text: Assign each provider to Track A, B or C by disclosure quality.

items.title: Convert
items.text: Capital spending to MW of capacity, with regional factors (cheaper Nordic sites, costlier tropical and urban ones).

items.title: Adjust
items.text: Apply power usage effectiveness: disclosed values where available, peer benchmarks otherwise.

items.title: Estimate and check
items.text: Per-query energy and cost, cross-checked by capex, GPU-hours and benchmarks; published in a dashboard.
